# $\Lambda_c^+ \to p K^- \pi^+$

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Model definition: [`lc2ppik-lhcb-2683025.json`](https://github.com/RUB-EP1/amplitude-serialization/blob/main/models/lc2ppik-lhcb-2683025.json).
:::

This notebooks illustrates the use of the [`ampform_dpd.io.serialization`](https://ampform-dpd.rtfd.io/0.2.1rc1/api/ampform_dpd.io.serialization.html) module for the decay $\Lambda_c^+ \to p K^- \pi^+$. The corresponding model was optimized to a data sample of roughly half a million $\Lambda_c^{\pm}$ decay candidates by the LHCb collaboration, [INSPIRE-HEP 2683025](https://inspirehep.net/literature/2683025).

::: {.callout-warning}
The [`ampform_dpd.io.serialization`](https://ampform-dpd.readthedocs.io/0.2.1rc0/api/ampform_dpd.io.serializatoin/) module is a preview feature. This notebook illustrates the deserialization of the amplitude model JSON file to symbolic expressions. Keep an eye on [ComPWA/ampform-dpd#133](https://github.com/ComPWA/ampform-dpd/issues/133) for a list of tracked issues.
:::

## Construct three-body decay

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
# | code-summary: Name-to-LaTeX converter
def to_latex(name: str) -> str:
    latex = {
        "Lc": R"\Lambda_c^+",
        "pi": R"\pi^+",
        "K": "K^-",
        "p": "p",
    }.get(name)
    if latex is not None:
        return latex
    mass_str = name[1:].strip("(").strip(")")
    subsystem_letter = name[0]
    subsystem = {"D": "D", "K": "K", "L": R"\Lambda"}.get(subsystem_letter)
    if subsystem is None:
        return name
    return f"{subsystem}({mass_str})"
```

```{python}
workspace = load_workspace(model_path, to_latex=to_latex)
model_definition = workspace.definition
model = workspace.distributions["default_model"]
decay = workspace.decays["default_model"]
Math(aslatex(decay, with_jp=True))
```

## Dynamics

::: {.callout.tip}
See also [RUB-EP1/amplitude-serialization#22](https://github.com/RUB-EP1/amplitude-serialization/issues/22) about serialization of custom lineshapes.
:::

```{python}
chain_definitions = get_decay_chains(model_definition)
```

### Vertices

#### Blatt-Weisskopf form factor

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
s, m1, m2, L, d = sp.symbols("s m1 m2 L R", nonnegative=True)
expr = FormFactor(s, m1, m2, L, d)
Math(aslatex(unfold_definitions(expr)))
```

```{python}
ff_L1520 = formulate_form_factor(
    vertex=chain_definitions[2]["vertices"][0],
    model=model_definition,
)
Math(aslatex(ff_L1520))
```

### Propagators

#### Breit-Wigner

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
s, m0, Γ0, m1, m2, L, d = sp.symbols("s m0 Gamma0 m1 m2 L R", nonnegative=True)
expr = BreitWigner(s, m0, Γ0, m1, m2, L, d)
Math(aslatex(unfold_definitions(expr)))
```

```{python}
k892_bw = formulate_breit_wigner(
    propagator=chain_definitions[20]["propagators"][0],
    resonance=to_latex(chain_definitions[20]["name"]),
    model=model_definition,
)
Math(aslatex(k892_bw))
```

#### Multi-channel Breit-Wigner

The `gsq` value that is serialized for each channel is the **coupling squared**, not an energy width. The channel term $\Gamma^\text{ch}$ below follows the same convention as [`HadronicLineshapes.jl`](https://mmikhasenko.github.io/HadronicLineshapes.jl/dev/10-breitwigner/#Multichannel-Breit-Wigner-Function). See [ComPWA/ampform-dpd#199](https://github.com/ComPWA/ampform-dpd/pull/199).

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
# | column: page-inset-right
s, m0, m1, m2, L, d = sp.symbols("s m0 m1 m2 L R", nonnegative=True)
channels = tuple(
    ChannelArguments(
        s,
        m0,
        coupling_squared=sp.Symbol(f"g_{{{i}}}^2", nonnegative=True),
        m1=sp.Symbol(f"m_{{a,{i}}}", nonnegative=True),
        m2=sp.Symbol(f"m_{{b,{i}}}", nonnegative=True),
        angular_momentum=sp.Symbol(f"L{i}", integer=True, nonnegative=True),
        meson_radius=d,
    )
    for i in [1, 2]
)
expr = MultichannelBreitWigner(s, m0, channels)
Math(aslatex(unfold_definitions(expr)))
```

```{python}
# | column: page-inset-right
l1405_flatte = formulate_multichannel_breit_wigner(
    propagator=chain_definitions[0]["propagators"][0],
    resonance=to_latex(chain_definitions[0]["name"]),
    model=model_definition,
)
Math(aslatex(l1405_flatte))
```

#### Breit-Wigner with exponential

The Bugg lineshapes are serialized as `generic_function` expression strings. The built-in dynamics builder parses these expressions and substitutes $i$ and $\sigma$ with the imaginary unit and the Mandelstam variable of the propagator node, respectively.

```{python}
get_function_definition("K700_BuggBW", model_definition)
```

```{python}
k700_bugg_bw = formulate_dynamics(chain_definitions[18], model_definition, to_latex)
Math(aslatex(k700_bugg_bw))
```

## Construct amplitude model

### Unpolarized intensity

```{python}
# | column: page-inset-right
λ0, λ1, λ2, λ3 = sp.symbols("lambda(:4)", rational=True)
amplitude_expr, _ = formulate_aligned_amplitude(model_definition, λ0, λ1, λ2, λ3)
amplitude_expr.cleanup()
```

### Amplitude for the decay chain

#### Helicity recouplings

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
λa = sp.Symbol(R"\lambda_a", rational=True)
λb = sp.Symbol(R"\lambda_b", rational=True)
λa0 = sp.Symbol(R"\lambda_a^0", rational=True)
λb0 = sp.Symbol(R"\lambda_b^0", rational=True)
f = sp.Symbol("f", integer=True)
l = sp.Symbol("l", integer=True, nonnegative=True)
s = sp.Symbol("s", nonnegative=True, rational=True)
ja = sp.Symbol("j_a", nonnegative=True, rational=True)
jb = sp.Symbol("j_b", nonnegative=True, rational=True)
j = sp.Symbol("j", nonnegative=True, rational=True)
exprs = [
    HelicityRecoupling(λa, λb, λa0, λb0),
    ParityRecoupling(λa, λb, λa0, λb0, f),
    LSRecoupling(λa, λb, l, s, ja, jb, j),
]
Math(aslatex({e: e.doit(deep=False) for e in exprs}))
```

```{python}

Math(aslatex({e: e.doit(deep=False) for e in recouplings}))
```

### Validation

The table lists the validation checks and their status. The marks "🟢", "🟡", and "🔴" indicate an accuracy of $<10^{-10}$, $<10^{-2}$, or $\ge10^{-2}$, respectively, for the difference between the reference and computed values.

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
# | code-summary: Render checksum results
# | column: page-inset
def round_number(value: float | complex | None, digits: int = 6) -> float | complex | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    number = complex(value)
    if number.imag == 0:
        return round(number.real, digits)
    return complex(round(number.real, digits), round(number.imag, digits))


def label_diff(difference: float) -> str:
    if difference < 1e-10:
        return "🟢"
    if difference < 1e-2:
        return "🟡"
    return "🔴"


validation_results = validate_checksums(workspace, backend="jax")
pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "Distribution": result.target,
            "Point": result.point_name,
            "Reference": round_number(result.reference),
            "Computed": round_number(result.value),
            "Difference": result.difference,
            "Status": label_diff(result.difference),
            "Diagnostic": result.diagnostic,
        }
        for result in validation_results
    ],
    dtype=object,
)
```

## Visualization

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
# | code-summary: Configure the visualizations
def select_resonance_parameters(model, resonance_name: str | None):
    if resonance_name is None:
        return model.parameter_defaults
    return {
        symbol: value
        if not str(symbol).startswith("c^") or resonance_name in str(symbol)
        else 0
        for symbol, value in model.parameter_defaults.items()
    }


i, j = 2, 1
k, *_ = {1, 2, 3} - {i, j}
resolution = 1_000
masses = sorted(model.masses, key=str)
x_min = float(((masses[j] + masses[k]) ** 2).xreplace(model.masses))
x_max = float(((masses[0] - masses[i]) ** 2).xreplace(model.masses))
y_min = float(((masses[i] + masses[k]) ** 2).xreplace(model.masses))
y_max = float(((masses[0] - masses[j]) ** 2).xreplace(model.masses))
x_margin = 0.05 * (x_max - x_min)
y_margin = 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)
x_grid, y_grid = jnp.meshgrid(
    jnp.linspace(x_min - x_margin, x_max + x_margin, num=resolution),
    jnp.linspace(y_min - y_margin, y_max + y_margin, num=resolution),
)
coordinates = (f"sigma{i}", f"sigma{j}")
compiled_workspace = compile_workspace(
    workspace,
    backend="jax",
    targets=["default_model"],
    coordinates=coordinates,
)
intensity_function = compiled_workspace.functions["default_model"]
intensities = intensity_function({f"sigma{i}": x_grid, f"sigma{j}": y_grid})
normalized_intensities = intensities / jnp.nansum(intensities)


def get_decay_products(
    decay: ThreeBodyDecay,
    subsystem: FinalStateID,
) -> tuple[State, State]:
    return tuple(s for s in decay.final_state.values() if s.index != subsystem)


sigma_labels = {
    subsystem: Rf"$\sigma_{subsystem} = M^2\left({' '.join(p.latex for p in get_decay_products(decay, subsystem))}\right)$"
    for subsystem in (1, 2, 3)
}
# cspell:ignore bbox edgecolor facecolor fontset fontsize labelcolor mathtext ncol savefig
# cspell:ignore sharey startswith STIX wspace xtick ytick
plt.rcParams.update({
    "axes.edgecolor": "#808080",
    "axes.facecolor": "none",
    "axes.labelcolor": "#808080",
    "figure.facecolor": "none",
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["STIXGeneral", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 18,
    "mathtext.fontset": "stix",
    "savefig.transparent": True,
    "text.color": "#808080",
    "xtick.color": "#808080",
    "ytick.color": "#808080",
})
```

```{python}
# | code-fold: true

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
mesh = ax.pcolormesh(x_grid, y_grid, normalized_intensities, rasterized=True)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.set_xlabel(sigma_labels[i])
ax.set_ylabel(sigma_labels[j])
divider = make_axes_locatable(ax)
colorbar_axes = divider.append_axes("right", size="5%", pad=0.1)
```

```{python}
# | code-fold: true
# | code-summary: Render the mass projection
# | column: page-inset-right
resonance_names = sorted({chain["name"].split("[")[0] for chain in chain_definitions})


def project(intensity_values, subsystem: int):
    if subsystem == i:
        mass_values = jnp.sqrt(x_grid[0])
        projection = jnp.nansum(intensity_values, axis=0)
    else:
        mass_values = jnp.sqrt(y_grid[:, 0])
        projection = jnp.nansum(intensity_values, axis=1)
    return mass_values, mass_values * projection


projections = {}
normalizations = {}
for subsystem in (i, j):
    mass_values, total_projection = project(intensities, subsystem)
    projections[subsystem] = (mass_values, total_projection)
    normalizations[subsystem] = jnp.trapezoid(total_projection, mass_values)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6), sharey=True)
for axis, subsystem in zip(axes, (i, j), strict=True):
    mass_values, total_projection = projections[subsystem]
    axis.plot(
        mass_values,
        total_projection / normalizations[subsystem],
        color="#808080",
        lw=3,
        label="Total",
    )
for resonance_name in resonance_names:
    compiled_component = compile_workspace(
        workspace,
        backend="jax",
        targets=["default_model"],
        coordinates=coordinates,
        parameter_overrides=select_resonance_parameters(
            model,
            to_latex(resonance_name),
        ),
    )
    component_function = compiled_component.functions["default_model"]
    component = component_function({"sigma1": y_grid, "sigma2": x_grid})
    component = jnp.where(jnp.isnan(intensities), jnp.nan, component)
    for axis, subsystem in zip(axes, (i, j), strict=True):
        mass_values, component_projection = project(component, subsystem)
        axis.plot(
            mass_values,
            component_projection / normalizations[subsystem],
            label=resonance_name,
        )
axes[0].set_xlabel(R"$m_{13}$ [GeV]")
axes[1].set_xlabel(R"$m_{23}$ [GeV]")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Normalized intensity (a.u.)")
axes[0].set_ylim(bottom=0)
handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(
    handles,
    labels,
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.97),
    fontsize="small",
    loc="upper center",
    ncol=7,
)
fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.8, wspace=0.05)
plt.show()
```
